# Debugging Exercises

## When to Use

- Fixing intentional syntax/logic errors in CT08_12 and CT08_13
- Providing educational explanations of bugs
- Guiding students through debugging process

## Procedure

1. Read the target Python file to identify syntax and logic errors
2. Provide step-by-step fixes for each error
3. Explain the nature of each mistake and why it occurs
4. Reference correct implementations (e.g., [CT08_12/lesson12.py](CT08_12/lesson12.py)) for comparison
5. Suggest running the fixed code to verify

## Common Error Patterns

- Assignment (=) instead of comparison (==) in conditionals
- Indentation issues in loops and conditionals
- Unterminated strings or missing quotes
- Incorrect try-except structure
- Logic errors in algorithms (e.g., off-by-one in loops)

## Resources

- Reference correct code in [CT08_12/lesson12.py](CT08_12/lesson12.py)
- See workspace instructions for debugging conventions
